mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a gunite and a fiberglass pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gunite and fiberglass pools differ primarily in construction and material. Gunite pools are custom-built on-site, using rebar framework sprayed with a concrete mixture (gunite) to create a highly durable and customizable shell. This allows for limitless shapes, depths, and features. Fiberglass pools are pre-formed shells manufactured off-site and then delivered and installed. While typically quicker to install, they offer fewer customization options in terms of size and shape compared to gunite. Gunite pools also allow for a wider variety of interior finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gunite pools are custom-built concrete shells offering high customization, while fiberglass pools are pre-made shells with quicker installation but limited design options.
